question: Should the generic tool-progress kind and predicate become the durable public plugin-SDK contract for transient progress payloads?
rationale: The existing fast-mode kind supports this direction, but expanding public third-party API is compatibility-sensitive and repository policy requires explicit owner intent.

options.title: Approve generic progress intent
options.body: Keep the closed generic kind and predicate, then enforce them consistently across every Slack delivery representation with contract tests.

options.title: Keep the seam internal
options.body: Move tool-progress classification behind an internal runtime boundary and avoid expanding third-party plugin API in this PR.

recommendation.title: Approve generic progress intent
recommendation.body: Keep the closed generic kind and predicate, then enforce them consistently across every Slack delivery representation with contract tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns both the Slack native-block delivery path and much of the plugin-SDK boundary affected by this decision.
